mapper.select: SELECT p.*, u.nickname AS artistNickname, u.avatar AS artistAvatar FROM dimension_commission_plan p LEFT JOIN dimension_user u ON u.id = p.artist_id WHERE p.id = #{planId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dimension_commission_plan (artist_id, title, price, delivery_days, cover_url, status, content_type, create_time) VALUES (#{artistId}, #{title}, #{price}, #{deliveryDays}, #{coverUrl}, #{status}, #{contentType}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT p.*, u.nickname AS artistNickname, u.avatar AS artistAvatar FROM dimension_commission_plan p INNER JOIN dimension_user u ON u.id = p.artist_id WHERE p.status = 1 AND u.artist_status = 2 ORDER BY p.id DESC LIMIT #{pageNum}, #{pageSize}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dimension_commission_plan p INNER JOIN dimension_user u ON u.id = p.artist_id WHERE p.status = 1 AND u.artist_status = 2
SELECT * FROM dimension_user WHERE artist_status = 2 AND accept_commission = 1 ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{pageNum}, #{pageSize}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dimension_user WHERE artist_status = 2 AND accept_commission = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE dimension_user SET accept_commission = #{accept} WHERE id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dimension_commission_order (order_no, plan_id, buyer_id, artist_id, requirement, amount, status, content_type, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{planId}, #{buyerId}, #{artistId}, #{requirement}, #{amount}, #{status}, #{contentType}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.sql: SELECT o.*, p.title AS planTitle, p.delivery_days AS deliveryDays, b.nickname AS buyerNickname, b.avatar AS buyerAvatar, a.nickname AS artistNickname, a.avatar AS artistAvatar FROM dimension_commission_order o LEFT JOIN dimension_commission_plan p ON p.id = o.plan_id LEFT JOIN dimension_user b ON b.id = o.buyer_id LEFT JOIN dimension_user a ON a.id = o.artist_id
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM dimension_commission_order WHERE id = #{orderId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM dimension_commission_order WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} FOR UPDATE
WHERE o.buyer_id = #{buyerId} ORDER BY o.id DESC
WHERE o.artist_id = #{artistId} ORDER BY o.id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE dimension_commission_order SET status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{orderId}
UPDATE dimension_commission_order SET status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE order_no = #{orderNo}
UPDATE dimension_commission_order SET transaction_id = #{transactionId} WHERE order_no = #{orderNo}
UPDATE dimension_commission_order SET status = 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} AND status = 0
UPDATE dimension_commission_order SET status = 3, platform_fee = #{platformFee}, artist_income = #{artistIncome}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{orderId} AND status = 2

UPDATE dimension_commission_order SET status = 4, close_time = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{orderId}
AND status IN (1, 2) AND status = 1
UPDATE dimension_commission_order SET status = 5, close_time = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{orderId} AND status = 0
mapper.select: SELECT id, order_no, buyer_id, artist_id, amount, status, create_time FROM dimension_commission_order WHERE status = 0 AND create_time < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{minutes} MINUTE) ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

where.if: AND (o.order_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR b.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR a.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dimension_commission_order o LEFT JOIN dimension_user b ON b.id = o.buyer_id LEFT JOIN dimension_user a ON a.id = o.artist_id

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS waitingPay, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS drawing, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS waitingAccept, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS finished, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS refunded, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS closed, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status IN (1, 2, 3) THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS paidAmount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 3 THEN platform_fee ELSE 0 END), 0) AS platformFee, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 3 THEN artist_income ELSE 0 END), 0) AS artistIncome FROM dimension_commission_order
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dimension_transaction (order_no, buyer_id, artist_id, amount, type, transaction_id, create_time) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{buyerId}, #{artistId}, #{amount}, #{type}, #{transactionId}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM dimension_transaction WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} ORDER BY id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dimension_order_log (order_id, operator_id, action) SELECT id, #{operatorId}, #{action} FROM dimension_commission_order WHERE order_no = #{orderNo}
INSERT INTO dimension_order_log (order_id, operator_id, action) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{operatorId}, #{action})
